title: FSS complete program — evidence-native owner-authorized sensor control plane
description:
## Mission

Deliver the complete Franken Surveillance System as a deterministic, evidence-native semantic control plane for owner-authorized physical sensors. This epic is the single program root for every work package, cross-cutting gate, risk, research decision, and documentation-derived closure task.

## Canonical architecture

The implementation must preserve one linked abstraction tower: runtime authority/custody → source evidence → world facts and coverage → derived beliefs → SituationCapsule/SituationFrame/WorldEnvelope → investigation and hypotheses → nondominated affordance frontier → witnessed plan/effect/obligation → outcome/episode → learning/memory → workspace/handoff. Mission, ObjectiveContract, ContractBasis, semantic protocol, privacy/capability projection, and full cost remain cross-cutting coordinates.

## Non-negotiable constraints

Rust 2024 on the pinned nightly; Asupersync is the sole async orchestration model; every workspace crate/target/example/test/build helper forbids unsafe code; production media/model/graph/storage/protocol semantics are first-party pure Rust; authority reaches every I/O/time/effect boundary explicitly; canonical history is one ordered EvidenceDeltaBatch universe; negative reads require CoverageWitness; ATP moves immutable object graphs and never effect authority; publication is child-first/root-last; stable IDs are never renumbered; protected high-loss possible worlds survive ranking, compression, transfer, view changes, and handoff.

## Program completion

This epic closes only when every required child is complete, all release-gate beads have retained proof, all risk controls are terminal or explicitly accepted with scope, all open questions needed by the release have ADR-backed outcomes, and GATE-120 publishes a complete locally qualified release root. Code presence, schema presence, a happy-path demo, or hosted CI success is never completion.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every planned capability is represented by a self-contained child bead with explicit success, failure, migration, security/privacy, cost, documentation, and proof semantics.
- Parent-child structure and true blocking dependencies are acyclic and reflect implementable vertical slices.
- Every consequential subsystem has deterministic reference, unit/property, differential, fault/crash/cancellation, integration, end-to-end, resource, and release evidence.
- All acceptance claims trace to stable requirements, machine registries, qualification lanes, and retained proof roots.
- The aggregate local DSR release is published root-last only after the complete required native matrix, artifact custody, canary, upgrade/rollback, and public verification pass.

title: PROGRAM-GOV — Program governance, source drift, and requirement coverage

Own the machine-versus-normative reconciliation work, stable identifier policy, complete source-to-bead coverage map, status honesty, and change-control rules. This epic prevents duplicated identifiers, prose-only requirements, and claim drift from being silently normalized.

## Program role

This is a cross-cutting coordinate under the complete FSS program. Its children attach to the relevant work packages and gates; it does not create a rival architectural layer. Work must preserve stable IDs, exact authority anchors, proof-linked status, and the root-last completion doctrine.

title: DRIFT-001 — Repair duplicate GOAL-019 and GOAL-020 identities
description:
Observed contract drift
The plan assigns these stable goal IDs to more than one concept. Select canonical existing identities, allocate new never-reused IDs for distinct concepts, tombstone superseded rows, update registries/mirrors/links, and prove no receipt becomes ambiguous.

Required resolution
Treat machine registries and schemas as authoritative once reconciled, but do not discard prose intent or silently renumber stable IDs. Record the competing sources, owning contract, chosen resolution, tombstones/crosswalks, migration and compatibility effect, affected tests/proofs/claims, and a generated guard against recurrence. Until resolved, dependent release claims remain explicitly blocked or ambiguous.

Verification
Run duplicate/reference/completeness validation over the entire corpus and retain before/after evidence. Add deterministic regression fixtures for the exact drift. Confirm every inbound reference resolves to one semantic owner and every generated mirror is coherent.
acceptance_criteria: All 25 source goal definitions are accounted for: GOAL-001 through GOAL-023 plus the second distinct meanings currently colliding at GOAL-019 and GOAL-020. The reviewed machine registry assigns exactly one semantic owner to every active identity, allocates never-reused successors or explicit tombstones/crosswalks where required, and preserves every original capability and restriction without prematurely prescribing the final active-ID count. All inbound references, schemas, generators, documentation, beads, tests, proof metadata, migrations, compatibility rules, and claim effects agree. Definition-aware regression fixtures fail on both current collisions, exact repeats, conflicting repeats, dangling aliases, accidental reuse, and silent renumbering; structured before/after evidence proves that historical identities remain resolvable and release claims remain blocked until ambiguity is eliminated.

# ADR-0002 — Isolate foreign codecs, vendor integrations, and model runtimes in boundary processes

**Status:** Superseded by [`ADR-0005`](ADR-0005-pure-rust-production-universe.md) and [`ADR-0010`](ADR-0010-foreign-runtimes-are-lab-oracles.md)

## Historical decision

The bootstrap architecture proposed running native codec stacks, vendor SDK/app automation,
Python/CUDA model runtimes, and broad provider clients outside the authoritative safe-Rust core,
communicating through versioned bounded local protocols.

## Why this was insufficient

Process isolation narrows crash and authority propagation, but it does not make the shipping system
pure Rust or close the semantic/dependency universe. A required foreign service still imports a
second runtime, memory-safety model, scheduler, parser stack, supply chain, update channel, and
model/media interpretation into production.

## Replacement

Production FSS media, model, graph, archive, and orchestration paths are first-party safe Rust.
Foreign tools can remain pinned, isolated differential oracles in qualification laboratories. A
missing first-party implementation means the capability remains unsupported or fails closed; it
does not silently activate a foreign production fallback.


Operationalization requirements:
1. Treat machine registries/schemas as higher authority, but record and repair any disagreement rather than choosing convenient text.
2. Preserve stable identities, assumptions, alternatives, failure/unknown states, privacy/security limits, costs, qualification and claim boundaries.
3. Add deterministic source-digest and heading/row coverage checks with typed drift diagnostics and owner/repair guidance.
4. Update the bead and its dependent proof whenever the source is deliberately changed; generated prose must remain a mirror, not a parallel contract.
acceptance_criteria: Every affected implementation and registry edge conforms to the embedded ADR; deterministic architecture checks and adversarial fixtures reject the prohibited alternative, feature leakage and transport-specific bypass. The ADR identity and source digest appear in ContractBasis/traceability and retained policy proof. Any supersession is explicit, compatible or migrated, and never silently edits history.

# ADR-0003 — Drone capture is human-piloted; FSS has no flight-control authority

**Status:** Accepted for architecture bootstrap

## Decision

FSS may guide a calibration capture mission and ingest authorized drone video/telemetry, but it
will not autonomously launch, navigate, pursue, or control a drone in this project.

Capture/registration is useful without taking on collision avoidance, airspace, geofencing,
physical safety, vendor SDK support, or adversarial pursuit. The DJI Flip support surface is also
not assumed.

The MCP/CLI capability registry contains no drone flight effect. Any future autonomous robotics
work requires a separate safety case and project boundary.

# ADR-0004 — Models are immutable qualified generations, not mutable names

**Status:** Accepted for architecture bootstrap

## Decision

A model generation binds exact weights/files, source revision, license, runtime, accelerator,
preprocessing, output schema, resource envelope, and qualification bundle. Activation is atomic and
rollback retains the prior generation.

## Rationale

Model names and Hugging Face repository heads drift. Scores cannot be reproduced or compared
without exact byte and runtime identity, and license restrictions may differ across variants.

## Consequences

Acquisition is explicit, build scripts remain offline, every result carries generation identity,
and research-only/noncommercial models cannot silently enter default release profiles.

# ADR-0005 — Close the production universe around pure Rust and first-party substrate

**Status:** Accepted

## Decision

FSS production code consists of FSS workspace crates, Asupersync, admitted Franken-suite crates,
and a tiny machine-registered set of foundational exceptions. FSS crates inherit
`unsafe_code = "forbid"`. Tokio, alternate runtimes, Python/PyO3, FFmpeg/libav, OpenCV, ONNX
Runtime, libtorch, proprietary SDKs, generic graph/search/database engines, browser runtimes, and
dynamic plugin systems are not production dependencies.

## Rationale

FSS handles untrusted media, credentials, private imagery, physical-world decisions, and long-lived
evidence. Owning the dependency, execution, parser, persistence, and cancellation semantics is
necessary for deterministic replay, memory safety, local qualification, and honest failure modes.
Focused first-party implementations can also outperform general stacks by exploiting FSS's narrow
workloads without sacrificing safety.

## Consequences

Capabilities land only when a first-party Rust path passes its admission gate. Foreign tools remain
useful as pinned differential oracles. The repository carries a dependency constitution, exact
sibling revision closure, offline build rule, and no-runtime-download policy.


Operationalization requirements:
1. Treat machine registries/schemas as higher authority, but record and repair any disagreement rather than choosing convenient text.
2. Preserve stable identities, assumptions, alternatives, failure/unknown states, privacy/security limits, costs, qualification and claim boundaries.

**Status:** Accepted

Canonical history is published as immutable `EvidenceDeltaBatch` roots. Graphs, search indexes,

root-last replication, and exact stale-result reporting.

# ADR-0007 — ATP moves immutable object graphs, never mutation authority

**Status:** Accepted

## Decision

Asupersync ATP is the bulk movement plane for media, checkpoints, evidence bundles, model packages,
graph/search/calibration/twin generations, replay corpora, and release artifacts. Alerts, PTZ,
deletion, retention changes, activation, and any future physical control use separate semantic
effect protocols with idempotency, fencing, observation, and reconciliation.

## Rationale

Bulk transfer is resumable, repairable, and eventually delivered; consequential effects require
precise authority and outcome semantics. Conflating the two makes retries unsafe and transfer
acceptance look like physical completion.

## Consequences

ATP receipts prove object closure, post-repair digests, root publication, and retrievability. They
cannot authorize an effect.

A clean-snapshot local qualification executed through repository scripts and Doodlestein

`scripts/qualify.sh` is the one repository contract. Releases record exact sibling revisions,

# ADR-0010 — Foreign runtimes and incumbent implementations are laboratory oracles only

**Status:** Accepted

## Decision

FFmpeg/ffprobe, PyTorch/ONNX Runtime, NetworkX, C SQLite, Tantivy, browsers, and owner-authorized
vendor applications/SDKs may run in pinned isolated qualification environments. Their outputs are
untrusted comparator inputs. They do not ship, provide a production fallback, or define FSS
authority.

## Rationale

Incumbents are invaluable for differential conformance and reverse-engineering exact behavior. They
are not needed in the production closure once focused first-party implementations exist. Keeping
oracles outside production preserves independence while making compatibility claims measurable.

## Consequences

Conformance accounting distinguishes agreement, divergence, error-only agreement, unexercised, and
intentional unsupported behavior. Oracle outage cannot affect production operation.


Operationalization requirements:
1. Treat machine registries/schemas as higher authority, but record and repair any disagreement rather than choosing convenient text.

## Background
This epic restores a stable-contract family that existed in the normative sources but was absent from the executable Beads graph. It is an organization and closure boundary, not evidence that any child is implemented.

## Scope
Create and maintain one self-contained child bead per stable identity in REQ-GOALS-001. Children may proceed in parallel when their real prerequisites permit. Parent-child edges organize ownership; only explicit blocking edges impose execution order. Aggregate gates must consume retained child proof rather than treating this epic or source presence as completion.

title: GOAL-001 — Heterogeneous owner-authorized interoperability
description:
## Normative requirement
Stable identity: `GOAL-001`
Source: `COMPREHENSIVE_PLAN_FOR_FRANKEN_SURVEILLANCE_SYSTEM.md`, section 3.2

Definition 1: **Heterogeneous owner-authorized interoperability**

Integrate standards-based and selected proprietary devices while using normal owner authorization,

title: DRIFT-002 — Repair duplicate NS-9 and NS-10 North Star scenario identities
description:
Observed contract drift
The comprehensive plan reuses NS-9 and NS-10 for distinct North Star scenario meanings. These are scenario IDs—not non-goal IDs—and each duplicate currently prevents one stable identity from resolving to one semantic owner.

Required resolution
Census every definition and inbound reference; select canonical meanings without discarding either scenario; allocate stable successor IDs where required; preserve superseded identities as tombstones/crosswalks; and update machine registries, schemas, generators, tests, beads, proof metadata, and explanatory mirrors coherently. Record the competing sources, owning contract, chosen resolution, compatibility/migration effect, and affected claims. Do not silently renumber or let prose convenience outrank the reconciled registry.

Verification
Run duplicate/reference/completeness validation over the entire normative corpus and retain exact before/after evidence. Add deterministic regression fixtures for both duplicate pairs and malformed recurrences. Confirm every inbound NS reference resolves to exactly one intended scenario owner, tombstones remain addressable, generated projections agree, and dependent release claims remain blocked until ambiguity is eliminated.
acceptance_criteria: All 15 source scenario definitions are accounted for: NS-1 through NS-13 plus the second distinct scenarios currently colliding at NS-9 and NS-10. The reviewed scenario registry assigns exactly one semantic owner to every active identity, allocates never-reused successors or explicit tombstones/crosswalks where required, and preserves every original user outcome and safety restriction without prematurely prescribing the final active-ID count. All inbound references, schemas, generators, documentation, beads, fixtures, tests, proof metadata, migrations, compatibility rules, and release-claim effects agree. Definition-aware regression fixtures fail on both current collisions, exact repeats, conflicting repeats, dangling aliases, accidental reuse, and silent renumbering; structured before/after evidence proves that historical scenario identities remain resolvable.

title: Constitution: realize the SEC-001..010 security objectives
description:
## Background
This epic restores a stable-contract family that existed in the normative sources but was absent from the executable Beads graph. It is an organization and closure boundary, not evidence that any child is implemented.

## Scope
Create and maintain one self-contained child bead per stable identity in REQ-SECURITY-001. Every child preserves the exact source contract, semantic owner, authority and failure boundary, deterministic reference, unit/property/fault/end-to-end proof, structured logging, cost, migration, security/privacy, and claim implications. Children may proceed in parallel when their real prerequisites permit. Parent-child edges organize ownership; only explicit blocking edges impose execution order. Aggregate gates must consume retained child proof rather than treating this epic or source presence as completion.

title: SEC-001 — Least authority
description:

Source: comprehensive plan section 21.1; plan SHA-256 `62324cd43ca7a36ac909f588a02e53ffd64c06a31e24dffec751beece72391c0`.

## Rationale and boundary

title: Validate the complete declaration-only architecture constitution for GATE-000
description:
## Outcome
Provide the declaration-only closure required by GATE-000: prove that the architecture constitution is internally coherent and completely represented without waiting for later capability implementation, device/model qualification, full formal proof, performance measurement, or release rehearsal.

## Exact boundary
Census the active source bytes at execution time rather than hard-coding a historical total. The current skeleton policy checker reports 1,076 unique stable IDs, but that number is not yet authoritative: its regex omits the variable-width NS-* scenario family and set insertion can hide repeated definitions such as GOAL-019/020. The validator must use a machine-declared namespace grammar and distinguish definitions, references, aliases, successors, and tombstones before publishing per-family and total counts. Validate stable uniqueness and history, registry/schema parseability, source mirrors, cross-links, dependency directions, claim classes, threat/privacy/non-goal coverage, risk/open-question ownership, test/gate/lane declarations, source digests, and the honest architecture-only implementation status. REG-SCHEMAS-DECLARATION-001 and REG-SLOS-DECLARATION-001 are declaration inputs; their realization/measurement children are not.

## Non-completion semantics
This task must never report a camera, codec, model, graph algorithm, archive backend, alert path, agent task, or release as implemented or qualified merely because its ID, schema, or plan exists. It emits separate states for declared, implemented, directly tested, proof-retained, narrowly qualified, released, unsupported, drifted, and conflicted. Duplicate GOAL-019/020 and NS-9/10 definitions, the 250-versus-240 seed mismatch, source-mirror ownership, risk crosswalk, claim-table row drift, and dependency-exception classification drift remain explicit until their owning DRIFT beads are resolved.

## Reference and tests
Build a deterministic read-only reference validator over exact source bytes and machine data. Unit/property and corpus E2E tests cover omitted namespaces, variable numeric widths, definition-versus-reference classification, exact and conflicting duplicates, missing/extra/tombstoned IDs, invalid schema, dangling links, count drift, generated-prose overclaim, circular prerequisite edges, later-stage implementation leakage into the declaration gate, source mutation during scan, and unsupported rows. JSONL logs record source/digest/line, namespace grammar/version, occurrence kind, identity, semantic fingerprint, schema/row/check/finding/owner/repair, per-family counts, and the resulting GATE-000 evidence root.

## Gate consumption
GATE-000 and WPQ-000 consume this proof. Full cross-registry realization (REG-CROSS-REGISTRY-001), generated product documentation (DOC-002), complete traceability (DOC-001), formal targets, and release claim evaluation remain later deliverables and must not be prerequisites of this declaration audit.
acceptance_criteria: The validator deterministically covers the complete recorded source and machine corpus using a versioned exhaustive namespace grammar, including variable-width NS scenario IDs; it distinguishes definitions, references, aliases, successors, and tombstones and cannot hide duplicate meanings through set deduplication. Counts are recomputed from exact source digests and reported per family with no stale hard-coded total. Every drift/conflict is typed and owned; declaration, implementation, qualification, and release states cannot be conflated. Regression fixtures prove omitted namespaces, both current duplicate families, and dependencies on later realization are rejected from the GATE-000 declaration closure. Direct local policy execution retains structured logs and proof; no hosted status or source presence upgrades a claim.

title: Complete the GATE-000 declaration-stage security, privacy, and abuse-case review
description:
## Outcome
Perform the architecture-stage threat, privacy, abuse, and authority review required by GATE-000 without claiming that later controls have been implemented or independently qualified.

## Review scope
Review owner authorization; device/cloud/account/secret boundaries; hostile media/metadata/model text; network/process zones; dependency/oracle isolation; capability projection; stale grants/leases/fences; effect preparation/revalidation/idempotency/reconciliation; bystander/interior/audio/identity policy; mask invalidation; retention/export/deletion closure; support bundles; oppressive repurposing; possible-world preservation; multi-agent overreach; drone manual-only posture; and public claim misuse. Map every threat to SEC/PRIV/NONGOAL/INV/RISK stable rows, an owning implementation/test bead, expected failure state, proof lane, residual risk, and decision gate.

## Architecture-stage evidence
The output is a versioned review record and abuse-case matrix over declared contracts and current skeleton behavior. Missing implementation is recorded as planned/unsupported, not as a review failure hidden by prose. Unresolved high-loss ambiguity becomes a blocking risk/open question or ADR; it is never waived by a generic checklist.

## Tests and logging
A deterministic matrix checker rejects unowned threats, missing negative tests, implicit ambient authority, secrets in fixtures/logs, unbounded attack surfaces, policy without rollback, or claims without proof. Direct corpus tests include stolen account/device, compromised vendor/oracle, prompt injection, malicious media/model packages, stale authority, privacy-mask/calibration drift, deletion blockers, indeterminate alerts, coercive export, and high-loss residual-world compression. Structured logs contain threat/control/owner/evidence/status/residual/next-gate IDs and no sensitive payloads.
acceptance_criteria: Every architecture threat and privacy principle is mapped to exact stable contracts, implementation/test/proof owners, explicit unsupported state and residual risk; owner-authorization and prohibited-use boundaries are preserved; independent review findings and negative evidence are retained; GATE-000 consumes only the declaration review while GATE-120 still requires implemented security/privacy qualification; the direct matrix validator and adversarial corpus emit reproducible structured proof.

title: Qualify complete mission goals, explicit exclusions, and security/privacy requirements for release
description:
## Outcome
Aggregate retained proof for every GOAL-*, NONGOAL-*, SEC-*, and PRIV-* requirement without flattening their distinct semantics or using parent/source presence as completion.

## Why this aggregate exists
GATE-120 needs one machine-verifiable view of mission success and prohibited behavior, but direct dependencies from the release gate to dozens of rows would obscure ownership. This bead is a proof index only: every child row remains independently testable, and any missing, conflicted, expired, excluded, unsupported, indeterminate, or negative result remains visible.

## Approach
Build a deterministic requirement-to-proof closure keyed by exact stable IDs and current ContractBasis. For each row record owners, implementation/test beads, qualified profiles/tuples, gates/lanes, proof roots, scope/exclusions, coverage and possible-world limits, security/privacy transforms, cost, residual risk, expiry/invalidation, and public claim consequence. Duplicate GOAL-019/020 meanings cannot pass until DRIFT-001 establishes unambiguous successors/tombstones.

## Tests and logs
Unit/property tests cover missing/duplicate/cyclic/stale proof links, proof from wrong generation/profile, hidden exclusion, unsafe claim widening, and parent-close false positives. The direct release E2E verifier emits structured JSONL row decisions and an aggregate digest; it fails closed if any required row lacks current reproducible evidence or if an explicit non-goal is violated.

title: Continuously prove clause-level source-to-bead semantic closure
description:
## Outcome
Create a deterministic semantic-coverage audit that prevents identifier-only or boilerplate-only beads from passing as complete plan capture. The source set is every governed Markdown document after byte-identical mirror deduplication plus all machine registries, schemas, manifests, ADRs, scripts, and Rust contracts. Every normative clause, table row, state transition, named type, algorithm family, scenario, rejection, and proof obligation must map to one or more owning bead IDs whose bodies contain enough task-specific semantics to implement without reopening the source.

## Current drift this bead must close
The 2026-08-31 audit found broad generic tasks that omitted the exact Asupersync region tree; acquisition and event state names; ATP lifecycle distinctions; graph projection universes; facility-location/isomorphism/motif/k-core/planarity/link-prediction/hypergraph semantics; operation-specific temporal uncertainty; novelty limits; operator privacy transparency; and a current Rust digest re-export mismatch. Treat these as evidence that token/ID occurrence alone is insufficient.

## Required mechanism
Produce a versioned coverage artifact keyed by canonical source path, byte digest, section/row/clause identity, owning bead IDs, capture class (description, acceptance, comment, dependency, proof), and review disposition. Detect unmapped clauses, mappings only to generic boilerplate, contradictory owners, stale source hashes, duplicate mirrors, and source text whose stable IDs were preserved but semantics were lost. The audit is advisory until a human-reviewable mapping exists; it never silently rewrites source or tracker state.

## Proof, failure, and observability contract
Use a deterministic safe-Rust reference first. Preserve stable identities, exact ContractBasis/EvidenceAnchor and generation inputs, capability/privacy projection, typed unknown/redacted/stale/conflicted/indeterminate outcomes, bounded resources, and request→drain→finalize cancellation. Unit and property tests cover every transition and invariant. Fault tests cover malformed inputs, duplicates/reordering, stale anchors/generations, cancellation at every boundary, crash/restart, partial I/O, pressure, authority/privacy revocation, and incompatible versions. A realistic end-to-end script must exercise success plus safe failure through the public semantic surface and retain secret-free structured logs with scenario/seed, fixture/source root, authority/privacy, transition sequence, injected schedule/fault, budgets/observed work, outcome/error identity, decision/output digests, proof handles, cleanup/obligation state, and an exact reproduction command. No log may contain raw private media, credentials, or unbounded payloads.

title: Enforce FACT, DESIGN, HYPOTHESIS, TARGET, and OPEN evidence-label semantics
description:
## Outcome
Make plan and generated-report evidence labels machine-checkable and non-interchangeable. FACT means established by a checked source or direct repository inspection as of a stated date and scope. DESIGN is a proposed normative choice, not implementation. HYPOTHESIS is plausible and requires a measurement/experiment. TARGET is an acceptance objective, not a current result. OPEN is an unresolved question with an owner and decision gate. Unlabeled normative prose specifies desired behavior but never claims current implementation.

## Rules
Every decision/status/report projection preserves the label, source identity/as-of date where required, owner/gate for OPEN, falsifier/experiment for HYPOTHESIS, and proof pointer for any promotion. No documentation link, bead existence, source file, green workflow, benchmark target or vendor statement upgrades a label. Promotion is an append-only reviewed transition backed by retained evidence; contradiction or expiry can demote current usability without deleting history.

## Proof and observability
Use stable typed identities, exact ContractBasis/EvidenceAnchor and generations, bounded inputs/outputs, explicit authority/privacy, deterministic reference behavior, typed failure/cancellation/indeterminate states, and actionable retry/rebase/reconcile guidance. Unit/property tests cover invariants and boundaries; fault/e2e tests cover malformed/stale/duplicate/reordered input, crash/cancel/pressure/revocation and realistic success/safe-failure paths. Structured logs are secret-free and include scenario/seed, source/fixture root, authority/privacy, transitions, budgets/work, outcome/error, digests, proof handles, cleanup/obligations and reproduction command.
acceptance_criteria:
- A versioned validator rejects FACT without checked source/as-of scope, OPEN without owner/gate, HYPOTHESIS without validation path, and TARGET/DESIGN presented as achieved.
- Status/claim/report generators preserve labels across JSON, CLI, MCP and human rendering.
- Tests cover source expiry, contradictory evidence, vendor claims, green-but-unretained workflows, implementation without qualification, tombstoned/superseded labels and replay.
- E2e starts with a HYPOTHESIS/TARGET, retains an experiment/proof bundle, promotes only the supported scope, and leaves unsupported claims unchanged.

title: ADR-0011 — Enforce the agent cognitive operating membrane
description:
## Decision and purpose

Implement and continuously enforce the accepted ADR-0011 agent cognitive operating membrane. FSS spans device, packet, media, storage, model, geometry, graph/search, policy, effect, archive, privacy, and repair domains; exposing those subsystems directly would force every agent to reconstruct anchors, state machines, authority, uncertainty, prerequisites, costs, and next-step logic. A prose summary or a large tool catalog is not an adequate contract because both hide composition, omissions, provenance, contradictions, validity, and authority.

The membrane is a mission-relative, anchor-pinned, budgeted, capability/privacy-projected cognitive and control surface above lower semantic owners. It is derived: it does not create physical truth, own effect outcomes, grant authority, or establish a fourth truth plane.

## Canonical object and operation contract

Preserve this linked hierarchy and its stable registered schemas/identities:

MissionContract → ObjectiveContract; AgentSession → versioned AgentWorkspace → AgentSessionCapsule; SituationCapsule containing SituationFrame → WorldEnvelope, MeaningfulDelta, ContextPack plus SemanticCompressionReceipt, active cases/plans/obligations/resource state, categorized controlEnvelope, and nondominated ActionAffordance frontier; InvestigationCase → hypotheses/findings/probes/stop rules; ControlPlan → witnessed contingent DAG → prepared effects; ExecutionEpisode → ExperienceCapsule → feedback/learning proposals; HandoffCapsule → root-last minimum-sufficient continuity graph.

The public fss/1 grammar is exactly session.open, session.resume, session.orient, session.follow, query, investigate, plan, commit, wait, cancel, explain, handoff, feedback, and doctor. Domain behavior is represented by registered targets, queries, intent families, views, evidence handles, and prepared effects. Rust API, CLI, MCP, TUI, reports, and future surfaces project the same registries; a transport may omit an unqualified operation but may not redefine it.

## Epistemic, possibility, and control semantics

Keep knowledge state, provenance class, hypothesis disposition, access transform, operation outcome, and effect outcome orthogonal. SituationCapsule is the primary driver publication and SituationFrame is the minimum sufficient world model. WorldEnvelope preserves certified core facts and absences, all materially decision-distinct alternative worlds, common invariants, unresolved dimensions, and protected high-consequence adversarial residuals. Ranking, reranking, compression, pressure, view change, transfer, and handoff may not remove protected worlds.

Every compact view carries a SemanticCompressionReceipt, explicit omissions, continuations, and priced hydration handles. The controlEnvelope classifies each capability-valid nondominated affordance as robust, conditional, information-gathering, wait/watch, blocked, or unavailable against the exact WorldEnvelope. Consequential recommendations require robustness across protected worlds or explicit branch condition, approval, rollback/reconciliation, and residual risk. Recommendation never grants effect authority.

## Continuity, effects, and learning

Mission-critical state never lives only in conversation. Sessions, workspaces, cases, findings, plans, obligations, work claims, episodes, and handoffs are immutable revisions or root-last graphs. Long work is region-owned, authority-scoped, budgeted, resumable across request disconnect, and cancelled by request → drain → reconcile/compensate → finalize. No obligation or indeterminate effect may disappear during interruption, resume, rebase, or handoff.

Learning outputs remain evidence-linked advisory proposals, fixtures, hard negatives, procedures, or anti-patterns until separate validation and promotion. Trauma-guard evidence may demote, retire, revive, or invert transfer while retaining audit history; it never silently changes truth, policy, thresholds, privacy, retention, models, or authority.

## Rejected alternatives and failure guards

Add regression guards against one tool per subsystem, one natural-language super-endpoint, raw world dumps plus model reasoning, autonomous memory policy mutation, a fourth agent truth plane, and conversation-only workspace/handoff. Test stale/mixed anchors and generations, contradictions, uncertified absence, coverage loss, redaction, capability changes, pressure truncation, hidden effect authority, disconnect/cancel/crash, duplicate requests, lost acknowledgements, stale work claims, merge/rebase conflict, harmful learning transfer, and transport-specific degradation.

## Qualification and diagnostics

QL-AGENT-001 must retain cold/warm orientation, minimum-sufficiency and omission-counterfactual receipts; epistemic/provenance/hypothesis and absence/coverage fidelity; follow/silence/interrupt/disconnect/resume; hypotheses/VOI/stop rules; hard-clamped Pareto affordances and sensitivity; plan/effect/obligation closure; multi-agent claims/noninterference; root-last handoff under drift; learning/trauma guard; cross-surface equivalence; and robot-documentation checks.

Unit/property/reference/fault tests and realistic e2e scripts log scenario/seed, source and ContractBasis digests, mission/session/workspace/anchor, exact authority/privacy, WorldEnvelope and compression fingerprints, protected worlds, candidates/clamps/frontier, plans/effects/obligations, generations/invalidators, budgets/full costs, outcome/error/recovery, proof handles, continuations, cleanup, and reproduction command. Logs are bounded, secret-free, and do not contain raw private media.
acceptance_criteria: ADR-0011 is represented by one accepted, versioned, machine-linked architecture contract whose registry/schema/type/operation/view surfaces implement the exact membrane and canonical object hierarchy. The agent surface composes lower owners without becoming a truth or effect-authority plane; all public transports share the fss/1 grammar and omit rather than redefine unqualified operations. Deterministic reference, unit/property, omission-counterfactual, protected-world, cancellation/crash, multi-agent, handoff, learning, cross-surface, and realistic e2e qualification pass with bounded structured logs and a retained QL-AGENT-001 proof root. Every rejected alternative has a regression guard; drift among ADR, registries, schemas, implementation, proof, and docs blocks GATE-115.

The cost row declares unit=checkpoint, semantic steps=[freeze_anchor,materialize_state,seal_replay_tail,verify,publish_root], variable costs=[state_bytes,delta_count,indexes], and planning status=model_required.

The implied scope is authority-checkpoint publication and bounded crash recovery/replay while preserving exact anchors, state, sealed tail, indexes, verification, and root-last visibility. This context constrains reconciliation but does not authorize inventing a threshold, unit, aggregation window, evidence status, or achieved claim.

## Reconciliation contract

Census every source and inbound reference. Decide through review whether to add a canonical active SLO row, retarget COST-CHECKPOINT-001 to an existing exactly equivalent SLO, or preserve SLO-RECOVERY-001 as a tombstone with an explicit successor/crosswalk. Retain rationale, owner, scope tuple, measurement method, units/threshold, aggregation/window and quantile or confidence rule, exclusions, pressure/degradation behavior, qualification lane, platform/device/provider/profile applicability, validity/expiry/invalidators, status dimensions, migration, and claim/gate effect.

Declaration is not measurement or qualification. Missing/unavailable resources, unsupported tuples, partial matrices, timeouts, skips, stale evidence, and tombstones remain typed non-pass or not-applicable states; they never become a satisfied SLO. Stable IDs are not renumbered or reused.

## Tests, e2e, and logs

Add unit/property and registry fixtures for the exact dangling reference, duplicate/missing/wrong-family references, malformed targets/units/windows, incompatible/tombstoned successors, partial measurements, false achieved status, and source/schema drift. Logs are bounded and contain no secrets or private media.
acceptance_criteria: SLO-RECOVERY-001 resolves exactly once to a reviewed canonical active row or explicit tombstone/successor without inventing a target or claiming achievement. COST-CHECKPOINT-001 and every inbound reference agree with the SLO registry, schema, implementation, tests, qualification lane, proof, status, documentation, and migration. The row specifies owner, exact scope/applicability, method, units/threshold, window/aggregation/confidence, exclusions, resource/pressure behavior, validity and claim effect. Unit/property/registry, malformed, compatibility, partial/unavailable/stale, fault, and real-entrypoint e2e tests retain detailed structured logs. No incomplete evidence, unavailable tuple, tombstone, or declaration is counted as a pass.

title: Program: preserve and revalidate every negative-evidence constraint
description:
## Purpose

Make negative evidence a durable planning and qualification input rather than prose that agents must rediscover. A NEG entry records a failed or unsupported hypothesis, exact context, result, decision, and revival condition. It constrains architecture and claims but does not prove an implementation experiment occurred when the source record is architecture research.

## Lifecycle

Entries are immutable revisions with stable IDs, source/date/commit or research snapshot, hypothesis, setup tuple, evidence/provenance, result and uncertainty, decision class, affected claims/gates, owner, validity/expiry, contradictions, and revival condition. New evidence proposes supersession/revival; it never deletes history or silently activates an adapter, model, policy, authority, or readiness claim.

## Qualification

Generate bounded human/agent projections from the same ledger. Test missing fields, duplicate IDs, stale sources, conflicting evidence, unsupported-to-supported transitions, tombstones, revival without proof, cross-reference drift, and claim overstatement. Real workflows must consult applicable NEG entries and log exact revision, decision effect, evidence handles, and safe alternative without secrets or private media.
acceptance_criteria: Every stable NEG-* entry has one immutable self-contained child preserving its exact hypothesis, source/setup boundary, finding, decision, claim effect, and revival condition. Architecture research is not mislabeled as a local experiment. Each constraint is enforced by dependency/adapter/model policy and tested through deterministic validation plus the relevant real-entrypoint e2e lane. New evidence can supersede or revive an entry only through an evidence-linked immutable revision; history and negative results remain available and no constraint silently disappears.

title: NEG-001 — Preserve the DJI Flip SDK non-dependency constraint
description:
Hypothesis: DJI Flip can be treated as a normal officially supported DJI Mobile SDK source.

Architecture-research finding: the cited public supported-product material does not establish DJI Flip support. This is not represented as a locally executed implementation experiment.

Decision: do not make DJI Flip SDK support an architectural dependency. Support recorded-file media/telemetry import and owner-authorized capture-bridge laboratory experiments; flight remains manual. Unsupported live capture is an acceptable typed result and cannot be disguised as adapter acceptance, streaming, or readiness.

Revival condition: an official compatible SDK/product listing or a repeatable, owner-authorized, supportable capture surface for an exact device/firmware/controller/app/platform/account tuple.

Tests/e2e: validate dependency and adapter registries reject implied SDK support; exercise GATE-100 recorded import plus unavailable/unsupported live routes; test tuple drift, auth revocation, cancellation, privacy/taint, and misleading vendor claims. Logs bind NEG revision/source evidence, exact tuple and authority, route decision, outcome, costs, proof handles, claim effect, and reproduction command without credentials or private media.
acceptance_criteria: NEG-001 remains an immutable architecture-research constraint: FSS has no architectural or production dependency on unestablished DJI Flip Mobile SDK support. Recorded-file import and explicitly authorized capture-bridge experiments remain available; manual flight and exact device/app/firmware/account capabilities are explicit. Dependency/adapter checks and GATE-100 e2e fixtures reject unsupported-SDK claims and preserve unsupported results. Only official compatible support evidence or a repeatable owner-authorized supportable capture surface may trigger a reviewed revival revision; no history or restriction is silently removed.

title: NEG-003 — Preserve the decomposed model-cascade constraint
description:
Hypothesis: the newest large multimodal model can replace detection, tracking, geometry, and calibrated event policy as the complete security stack.

Architecture-research finding: latency, licensing, temporal grounding, reproducibility, calibration, privacy, cost, and failure isolation differ by task; no single current candidate establishes the complete contract. This is not represented as a locally executed implementation experiment.

Decision: preserve a progressive model cascade with immutable package, preprocessing, numeric, kernel, calibration, and policy generations plus held-out event gauntlets. Model output remains derived; abstention/failure is not negative evidence; one model is not independent corroboration; a VLM never triggers an effect directly.

Revival condition: one exact candidate passes every decomposed task, license, cost, privacy, deterministic/replay, calibration, resource, safety, and failure-isolation boundary against the incumbent on the same held-out workload.

Tests/e2e: compare candidates to the decomposed baseline per task/slice and complete cost vector; include temporal/occlusion/adversarial/abstention/shared-failure cases, shadow-only activation, rollback, pressure, and harmful regressions. Logs bind NEG and model/package/toolchain/hardware/corpus generations, raw metrics/calibration, divergences, authority/privacy, costs, decision/claim effect, proof roots, and reproduction command without weights, secrets, or private media.
acceptance_criteria: NEG-003 prevents any single frontier VLM or opaque model score from replacing detection, tracking, geometry, evidence custody, calibrated policy, independent verification, or effect authority. The progressive immutable-generation cascade and decomposed incumbent remain until a candidate passes every exact task, license, cost, privacy, deterministic, calibration, and safety boundary on the same held-out workload. Unit/policy and TEST-MODEL-QUALITY-001 real-entrypoint e2e comparisons retain raw metrics/divergences/negative evidence with exact model/toolchain tuples; no runtime latest download or direct effect trigger is possible.

title: DRIFT-008 — Reconcile contradictory Thiserror dependency-admission classifications
description:
## Observed contract drift
The machine authority architecture/dependency_allowlist.toml classifies only serde and serde_json as fundamental bounded data-shape dependencies subject to audit. It places thiserror among exception candidates that are not admitted without a DEP record, ADR, and release evidence. README.md, DEPENDENCY_CONSTITUTION.md, and the later comprehensive-plan dependency checklist agree with the machine authority. However, comprehensive-plan section 27.3 says the default external exception set includes Serde, Serde JSON, and Thiserror. That sentence can cause an implementer to admit thiserror without the required exception evidence.

## Required resolution
Preserve the machine allowlist as the current authority unless an explicitly reviewed constitutional change updates every owner. Reconcile the conflicting plan sentence and every generated or explanatory mirror. If thiserror remains an exception candidate, require its exact version/features, mechanism owner, DEP identity, ADR, transitive closure census, licenses/security review, no-unsafe and no-build-network evidence, operation-cost impact, offline locked resolution, and release-absence/presence claim semantics before admission. If policy intentionally changes, version the allowlist and compatibility/claim consequences rather than editing prose alone.

## Failure semantics and migration
An unresolved or multiply classified crate is a policy conflict and blocks dependency admission, GATE-000, and affected release claims. Existing lockfiles or source usage do not grandfather admission. Migration records must identify affected manifests, features, proof roots, toolchain/sibling closure, and rollback path; missing evidence produces a stable rejection with safe remediation.

## Tests and proof logging
Add deterministic table-driven and property tests over all dependency classes: in-house families, fundamental subject-to-audit dependencies, exception candidates, laboratory oracles, and forbidden crates/patterns. Fixtures include this exact contradiction, case/alias variants, duplicate membership, transitive-only reachability, feature-gated and target-specific entries, build/dev dependencies, stale docs, and a policy version change. A direct local policy E2E must fail the contradictory fixture and pass only the reconciled corpus. Emit bounded secret-free JSONL with source path/digest/line, policy version, crate/version/source/features/target/kind, every observed classification, required and present evidence, decision/error/repair, lock and closure digests, costs, and proof root.
acceptance_criteria: Thiserror has one unambiguous versioned classification across the machine allowlist, comprehensive plan, README, dependency constitutions, generated mirrors, manifests, lockfile policy, tests, proof metadata, and public claims. No exception candidate is treated as a default admission: a DEP record, ADR, exact version/features and source, closure/license/security/no-unsafe/offline evidence, cost row, and release evidence are mechanically required. Unit/property fixtures reject the current contradiction and every named overlap/alias/target/feature/transitive case. The direct local policy E2E retains structured before/after logs and content-addressed proof, and GATE-000 plus dependency realization remain blocked on any unresolved classification.

title: Enforce ADR 0001 three semantic planes
description:
Source-assimilation boundary:
Path: docs/adr/ADR-0001-three-semantic-planes.md
Role: This is a normative architecture decision. Preserve its context, decision, consequences and rejected alternatives as a binding constraint. Implementers must trace every affected registry/schema/crate/operation/test/claim edge and may supersede it only with a new explicit ADR and migration; convenience, hosted limitations or an upstream default cannot override it.

Full source snapshot at planning time:

# ADR-0001 — Separate authority, cognition, and effect planes

**Status:** Accepted for architecture bootstrap

## Decision

FSS separates:

- **authority:** immutable observations, identities, policies, receipts, and canonical state;
- **cognition:** tracks, embeddings, hypotheses, rankings, model outputs, and memories;
- **effects:** alerts, PTZ, retention, export, deletion, activation, and repair mutations.

Cognition may propose but cannot directly mutate authority or perform effects. Effects require
prepared intent, capability, precondition, idempotency identity, and receipt.

## Rationale

A model score is not a physical fact, and a provider ACK is not equivalent to an observed outcome.
Keeping the planes distinct preserves uncertainty, enables rollback/replay, and prevents model or
adapter code from becoming the trust root.

## Consequences

More explicit schemas and coordination are required. In exchange, failures remain classifiable and
agents can reason over evidence without ambient mutation authority.


Operationalization requirements:
1. Treat machine registries/schemas as higher authority, but record and repair any disagreement rather than choosing convenient text.
2. Preserve stable identities, assumptions, alternatives, failure/unknown states, privacy/security limits, costs, qualification and claim boundaries.
3. Add deterministic source-digest and heading/row coverage checks with typed drift diagnostics and owner/repair guidance.
4. Update the bead and its dependent proof whenever the source is deliberately changed; generated prose must remain a mirror, not a parallel contract.
acceptance_criteria: Every affected implementation and registry edge conforms to the embedded ADR; deterministic architecture checks and adversarial fixtures reject the prohibited alternative, feature leakage and transport-specific bypass. The ADR identity and source digest appear in ContractBasis/traceability and retained policy proof. Any supersession is explicit, compatible or migrated, and never silently edits history.

title: FSS-044 — Implement ONVIF capability negotiation
description:
## Outcome

Implement ONVIF capability negotiation. Deliver this as a complete vertical contract in the RTSP/RTP/ONVIF standards acquisition work package, not as a placeholder, mock-only path, or source-presence claim.

## Background and system role

This task contributes scoped discovery, auth/session, packet sequence/time truth, Profile T/M negotiation, fallback/reconnect, and leased PTZ verification. It must compose with one EvidenceAnchor/EvidenceDeltaBatch universe and preserve authority, cognition, and effect-plane ownership. Relevant non-negotiable invariants include INV-005, INV-007, INV-016, INV-024, INV-062.

## Required technical contract

Start with a deterministic reference implementation and typed state machine; expose explicit success, expected failure, cancellation, panic/quarantine, stale-generation, budget, and indeterminate outcomes before adding optimization or concurrency.

Treat all bytes and metadata as hostile: checked arithmetic, pre-allocation limits, explicit source spans and generation leases, cancellation between bounded units, quarantine on invariant failure, and no decoded/derived artifact inheriting source-evidence status.

Every public or durable object needs stable identity, explicit owner, bounded inputs/outputs, compatibility generation, validity/invalidators, cost row, privacy/capability projection, and structured errors with safe retry/rebase/reconcile/repair guidance. Optimization is admitted only after a simple oracle and same-semantic proof exist.

## Failure and recovery semantics

Cover malformed or missing input, duplicate/reordered work, stale anchors/generations, cancellation at each publication/effect boundary, crash/restart, partial I/O, resource pressure, unavailable dependencies, privacy/capability revocation, and incompatible versions. Preserve valid partial evidence but never upgrade an uncertain, stale, uncovered, redacted, or indeterminate state to success.

## Verification and diagnostic logging

Add focused unit and property tests plus deterministic reference, differential/metamorphic, fault/cancellation/crash, integration, and end-to-end scenarios appropriate to the task. Every scenario emits bounded structured logs containing scenario and seed, source/fixture root, ContractBasis and generations, authority/capability/privacy scope, injected schedule/fault, transition sequence, budgets and observed work, outcome/error identity, semantic/decision digest, proof handles, and minimal reproduction command. Logs must be secret-free and avoid raw private media.

## Completion boundary

Qualification is TEST-RTSP-001, TEST-ONVIF-001, and GATE-030. Completion requires implementation, success/failure semantics, migrations/compatibility, operation-cost evidence, tests, retained proof bundle, registry/schema/status updates, and user/agent-facing documentation to agree.
acceptance_criteria:
- The FSS-044 contract is implemented through the owning types/state machine with stable IDs, hard bounds, explicit authority, and deterministic reference behavior.
- Every named success state is distinguished from staged/accepted/provisional/derived/indeterminate states relevant to this task.
- Unit/property tests cover boundary values and invariants; fault tests cover malformed input, cancellation, crash, stale generation, duplicate/reorder, pressure, and authority/privacy changes.
- A realistic end-to-end script exercises the capability through its public semantic surface and records structured transition, cost, digest, receipt, and reproduction logs.
- Differential or compatibility claims name exact oracle/device/model/provider/toolchain tuples and retain divergences and negative evidence.
- Required schemas, registries, migrations, status, documentation, and proof roots agree; no claim exceeds retained evidence.

description:
## Normative invariant
Stable identity: `XFER-INV-001` — **immutable roots only**

## Exact source contract
ATP moves immutable named object graphs. Mutable session state, credential handles, effect authority, and live in-memory objects never ride inside the graph.

ATP never carries effect authority.

Unit/property/state-machine, fault-schedule, differential/reference, standalone receipt verification, and real-entrypoint E2E transfer tests emit JSONL with transfer/object/path/policy IDs, seed/schedule, state transitions, budgets/costs, expected/actual outcome, staged-child disposition, obligations/cleanup, digests and safe resume/reconcile guidance.

title: Reconcile and implement canonical ATP transfer, path, and archive lifecycles
description:
## Outcome
Reconcile the normative ATP documents into one registered transfer vocabulary without erasing their distinct layers. The semantic transfer lifecycle is Proposed → Reserved → Offered → Receiving → ChildrenVerified → GraphClosed → DurabilitySatisfied → RootCommitted → ReceiptSealed, with Rejected, Aborted, Quarantined, Indeterminate, and Superseded terminals. Archive publication additionally distinguishes manifest validation, fetching/staging, object verification, root publication, replication-policy satisfaction, retrievability verification, completion, scrubbing, and retirement. Path state is separately Discover → Candidate → Probing → Active → Suspect → Draining → Closed.

## Non-collapse rules
Offered, received, verified, graph-closed, durable, committed, published, replicated, retrievable, protected, and complete are never synonyms. Root visibility is last and requires verified child closure, post-repair canonical digests, authorization, and publication fence. Indeterminate means remote semantic commit may have occurred and lookup cannot resolve; it owns a durable reconciliation obligation. Cancellation drains all losing/in-flight paths and leaves a checksummed resumable journal. Delivery of bytes/path never grants retention, indexing, activation, or effect authority.

## Proof, failure, and observability contract
Use a deterministic safe-Rust reference first. Preserve stable identities, exact ContractBasis/EvidenceAnchor and generation inputs, capability/privacy projection, typed unknown/redacted/stale/conflicted/indeterminate outcomes, bounded resources, and request→drain→finalize cancellation. Unit and property tests cover every transition and invariant. Fault tests cover malformed inputs, duplicates/reordering, stale anchors/generations, cancellation at every boundary, crash/restart, partial I/O, pressure, authority/privacy revocation, and incompatible versions. A realistic end-to-end script must exercise success plus safe failure through the public semantic surface and retain secret-free structured logs with scenario/seed, fixture/source root, authority/privacy, transition sequence, injected schedule/fault, budgets/observed work, outcome/error identity, decision/output digests, proof handles, cleanup/obligation state, and an exact reproduction command. No log may contain raw private media, credentials, or unbounded payloads.

Legacy/cross-document state spellings retained for reconciliation include ManifestVerified, ObjectVerified, GraphClosureVerified, ExposureReady, RootPublished, ReplicaQualified and RetrievabilityVerified. They must map to a layer-qualified canonical state or remain a distinct registered state; no spelling is silently discarded.
acceptance_criteria:
- Machine registries/schemas define layer-qualified canonical states and an explicit crosswalk for legacy document names; no transport invents aliases.
- Deterministic reducers reject skipped publication, root-before-child, stale fence, receipt-before-commit, path-close-with-live-work, and archive-complete-without retrievability.
- Crash/cancel tests cut every journal/publication/path state and prove resume equivalence, idempotency, cleanup, cost accounting, and exact terminal obligations.
- Provider simulators cover partial listing, eventual consistency, duplicate delivery, repair, quota pressure, revocation, lost ACK, and unresolved remote commit.
- E2e transfer/archive scripts log both semantic and path transitions, digests, fences, object counts/bytes, provider tuple, proof-of-retrievability, and reproduction command.

title: FSS-064 — Implement multipart idempotency/reconciliation
description:
## Outcome

Implement multipart idempotency/reconciliation. Deliver a complete vertical contract in ATP archive and retrievability, not a placeholder or source-presence claim.

## Background and role

This task contributes immutable graph transfer, journals, closure, multipath drain, repair verification, provider protocols, costs, replicas, restore, and deletion. It composes with one EvidenceAnchor/EvidenceDeltaBatch universe and type-distinct authority, cognition, and effect planes. Governing invariants: INV-046/047/048/066/067/075.

## Technical contract

Begin with a deterministic reference and typed state machine. Expose success, expected error, cancellation, panic/quarantine, stale-generation, budget, and indeterminate outcomes before optimization or concurrency.

Use prepare→revalidate→persist-intent→commit/dispatch→observe→verify/reconcile; semantic idempotency conflicts fail, and lost acknowledgement after dispatch stays indeterminate until resolved.

Keep staged, verified, visible, durable, replicated, protected, and retrievable states distinct; publish root last, verify post-repair digest/closure, and include all derived/cache/replica/journal edges in cleanup.

Every public/durable object has stable identity, owner, bounds, compatibility generation, validity/invalidators, cost, privacy/capability projection, structured errors, and safe retry/rebase/reconcile/repair guidance. Optimizations require a simple oracle and same-semantics proof.

## Failure and recovery

Cover malformed/missing input, duplicate/reordered work, stale anchors, cancellation at publication/effect boundaries, crash/restart, partial I/O, pressure, unavailable dependencies, revoked authority/privacy, and incompatible versions. Preserve valid partial evidence; never upgrade uncertain, stale, uncovered, redacted, or indeterminate state.

## Tests, e2e, and logging

Add unit/property, deterministic reference, differential/metamorphic, fault/cancel/crash, integration, and realistic end-to-end scenarios. Structured logs include scenario/seed, fixture root, ContractBasis/generations, authority/privacy, injected fault/schedule, transitions, budgets/work, outcome/error, semantic digest, proof handles, and reproduction command; logs are secret-free and contain no raw private media.

## Completion

Qualification is QL-ARCHIVE-001, TEST-ARCHIVE-001, and GATE-040. Code, migrations, costs, tests, proof, registries/schemas/status, and user/agent docs must agree.
acceptance_criteria:
- FSS-064 has stable typed semantics, hard bounds, explicit authority, deterministic reference behavior, and safe failure/recovery guidance.
- Success is distinct from staged, accepted, provisional, derived, cancelled, failed, and indeterminate states relevant to the capability.
- Unit/property plus malformed, cancel, crash, stale-generation, duplicate/reorder, pressure, and authority/privacy tests pass.
- A realistic e2e script records detailed structured transition, cost, digest, receipt, and reproduction logs.
- Exact oracle/device/model/provider/toolchain identities, divergences, negative evidence, schemas, migrations, status, documentation, and proof roots are retained.

title: WP-080 — Pure-Rust model package and execution runtime
description:
## Outcome

Import, execute, optimize, qualify, activate, and roll back immutable model generations through a typed first-party Rust runtime.

## Background and architectural role

Define canonical model packages, tensor dtype/shape/layout/stride/view/version semantics, frozen operator IR, scalar operators, deterministic liveness/memory plans, static dispatch, safe tiled/SIMD/fused kernels, quantized generations, bounded scheduling, receipts, license policy, ATP custody, and shadow/canary activation. Python/PyTorch/ONNX/CUDA/OpenCV are lab-only comparators.

## Failure semantics and non-negotiable boundaries

A model name, loadable checkpoint, or one sample is not support. No runtime download or arbitrary code. Mixed score spaces are rejected. OOM, hang, crash, malformed output, unsupported operator, abstention, cancellation, and publication ambiguity are typed; partial tensors never become results or effects.

## Qualification and retained evidence

GATE-050; INT-FT-001..005; QL-MODEL-001; TEST-MODEL-HOST-001; operator/end-to-end differential; numeric and event-quality separation; adversarial tensors/media; memory/cancel/OOM; package corruption/repair; CPU fallback; held-out quality and license/custody proof.

## Completion boundary

The work package is complete only when its contracts, reference behavior, optimized/imported behavior, migrations, privacy/security policy, operation-cost rows, tests, proof bundles, compatibility claims, implementation status, and user-facing documentation agree.
acceptance_criteria:
- The epic’s complete contract is represented by granular child beads with explicit owners and true blocking edges.
- Child acceptance covers success and failure semantics, compatibility/migration, privacy/security, performance cost, observability, documentation/status, and retained proof.
- Unit/property, deterministic reference, differential, fault/cancellation/crash, integration, end-to-end, resource-economy, and release lanes are assigned where applicable.
- Closing this epic requires terminal proof for every required child; implementation or schema presence alone is insufficient.

## Background and role

This task contributes immutable packages, typed tensors/IR, scalar and safe optimized kernels, memory plans, receipts, quantization, licenses, and rollback. ## Technical contract

Begin with a deterministic reference and typed state machine. Expose success, expected error, cancellation, panic/quarantine, stale-generation, budget, and indeterminate outcomes before optimization or concurrency.

Bind results to exact input/package/preprocess/numeric/kernel/memory/calibration generations; failures and abstentions remain derived uncertainty, and production has no foreign-runtime fallback.

Pin an authorized immutable projection; declare exactness, semantics, tie-break/order, complexity/budget witness, and absence boundary; capability filtering precedes expansion and rank never authorizes effects.

Cover malformed/missing input, duplicate/reordered work, stale anchors, cancellation at publication/effect boundaries, crash/restart, partial I/O, pressure, unavailable dependencies, revoked authority/privacy, and incompatible versions. Preserve valid partial evidence; never upgrade uncertain, stale, uncovered, redacted, or indeterminate state.

Add unit/property, deterministic reference, differential/metamorphic, fault/cancel/crash, integration, and realistic end-to-end scenarios. title: WP-090 — Detection, segmentation, and tracking cascade
description:
## Outcome

Turn bounded media into progressively refined, anchor-pinned derived perception while minimizing expensive work and preserving candidate recall.

## Background and architectural role

Implement quality/tamper sentinel, deterministic activity gate, first detector/segmenter, tracker, open-vocabulary verifier, shared image pyramid, temporal state generation, candidate accounting, abstention, and held-out evaluation. Each stage records retained/dropped candidates, cost, uncertainty change, and model/source identities.

## Failure semantics and non-negotiable boundaries

A cheap gate may save work only with a demonstrated one-sided miss bound. Detection is not corroboration, a track is not a person, and failure/abstention expands uncertainty rather than becoming negative evidence. State never crosses packet gaps, stream/model/preprocess/privacy generations without migration.

## Qualification and retained evidence

GATE-050 and GATE-080; TEST-MODEL-QUALITY-001, TEST-INTRUSION-001, TEST-BENIGN-001, TEST-TAMPER-001; unit/property gates; staged cascade differential; adversarial threat slices; event-level metrics/calibration; pressure/thermal/cancel tests; detailed per-stage decision logs.

## Completion boundary

The work package is complete only when its contracts, reference behavior, optimized/imported behavior, migrations, privacy/security policy, operation-cost rows, tests, proof bundles, compatibility claims, implementation status, and user-facing documentation agree.
acceptance_criteria:
- The epic’s complete contract is represented by granular child beads with explicit owners and true blocking edges.
- Child acceptance covers success and failure semantics, compatibility/migration, privacy/security, performance cost, observability, documentation/status, and retained proof.
- Unit/property, deterministic reference, differential, fault/cancellation/crash, integration, end-to-end, resource-economy, and release lanes are assigned where applicable.
- Closing this epic requires terminal proof for every required child; implementation or schema presence alone is insufficient.

title: Implement open-set novelty escalation without threat laundering
description:
## Outcome
Add property-, mode-, environment-, and model-generation-specific open-set/embedding novelty as a candidate and investigation signal only. Novelty may raise inspection priority, request a verifier, retrieve similar hard negatives, or create an explicit unknown-object hypothesis. It cannot label novelty as threat, authorize or suppress an effect, rewrite canonical evidence, or compare embeddings across generations. Baselines are drift-monitored, privacy-scoped, and invalidated on deployment/model changes.

## Required distinctions
Preserve unusual object, unusual behavior, out-of-distribution input, low observability, model disagreement, and simply rare-but-benign as different signals. The evaluation corpus includes darkness, IR, compression, blur, tiny/partial/crouched/crawling subjects, dark clothing/masks, weather/foliage, animals including raccoon/cat/deer/bird/insect/spider web, shadows/reflections/displays/replay, camera motion, and resource pressure. “Usually a raccoon” memory may influence retrieval or request verification, never current truth.

## Proof, failure, and observability contract
Use a deterministic safe-Rust reference first. Preserve stable identities, exact ContractBasis/EvidenceAnchor and generation inputs, capability/privacy projection, typed unknown/redacted/stale/conflicted/indeterminate outcomes, bounded resources, and request→drain→finalize cancellation. Unit and property tests cover every transition and invariant. Fault tests cover malformed inputs, duplicates/reordering, stale anchors/generations, cancellation at every boundary, crash/restart, partial I/O, pressure, authority/privacy revocation, and incompatible versions. A realistic end-to-end script must exercise success plus safe failure through the public semantic surface and retain secret-free structured logs with scenario/seed, fixture/source root, authority/privacy, transition sequence, injected schedule/fault, budgets/observed work, outcome/error identity, decision/output digests, proof handles, cleanup/obligation state, and an exact reproduction command. No log may contain raw private media, credentials, or unbounded payloads.
acceptance_criteria:
- Novelty outputs identify embedding/model/index/baseline generations, property/privacy domain, calibration validity, drift status, nearest evidence handles, and typed unknown disposition.
- Generation mixing, baseline reuse after invalidation, identity claims, and direct effect authorization are rejected.
- Unit/property tests cover thresholds, ties, empty/low-quality inputs, drift, privacy TTL, and deterministic replay.
- Held-out/e2e scenarios include novel benign, familiar threat, crawling/raccoon ambiguity, OOD darkness, and model disagreement, proving novelty changes inspection but not truth or authority.
- Logs retain component scores and routing decision without raw identity-bearing embeddings.

title: Qualify verifier independence and shared model failure domains
description:
## Outcome
Define when a second detector, VLM, temporal model, geometry rule or modality provides independent verification rather than a correlated repeat. Independence is analyzed across training data, checkpoint lineage/model family, architecture, preprocessing, modality, source sensors, clocks/networks, calibration and observed failure history. Two sizes or prompts of the same VLM may be highly correlated; deterministic geometry/rules or a genuinely different detector/modality may be stronger.

## Contract
Every claimed corroborator pair/group emits a failure-domain decomposition, conditional-independence assumptions, measured joint-error evidence for the deployment regime, invalidators and an independence class. Unknown or shared domains reduce evidence weight or keep the event single-domain/unconfirmed. The verifier localizes supporting/contradicting evidence and may abstain; it never authorizes an effect or turns a model phrase into numeric confidence.

## Proof and observability

title: Implement anonymous household familiarity without mandatory biometric identity
description:

Support the operator-facing conclusion “familiar household activity, identity unresolved” without requiring face recognition or a permanent whitelist. Evidence may include an authorized door transition and path continuity, opt-in trusted device presence, short-lived property-local appearance/session association, routine time/path/action memory, operator confirmation and absence of forced-entry/tamper cues.

Appearance embeddings have short privacy TTLs and generation isolation. title: Implement calibrated sequential fusion with common-cause and abstention semantics
description:
## Outcome
Build an auditable deterministic fusion reference over calibrated likelihood/evidence intervals, missing data, contradictions, and declared common-cause failure domains. Candidate adaptive lanes may include conformal risk control for set-valued/abstaining output, e-values/e-martingales or other anytime sequential tests, bounded-prior-sensitivity Bayesian/likelihood models, defensible Dempster-Shafer-like evidence, and a learned shadow meta-model. No technique is admitted by elegance or raw score; it must beat the simple reference on sealed event-level evaluation without breaking calibration.

## Policy boundary
Sequential evidence may alert, wait for bounded imminent corroboration, request a better observation, alert with degraded coverage, retain silently, request operator confirmation, or reject. Every wait has deadline and expected value; optional stopping and false-alert exposure are measured. Severity, probability, expected harm, time criticality, reversibility, and false-alert cost remain distinct. Only adaptive routing changes online by default; safety/privacy, deployment, and calibrated decision policy require explicit versioned activation.

## Proof, failure, and observability contract
Use a deterministic safe-Rust reference first. Preserve stable identities, exact ContractBasis/EvidenceAnchor and generation inputs, capability/privacy projection, typed unknown/redacted/stale/conflicted/indeterminate outcomes, bounded resources, and request→drain→finalize cancellation. Unit and property tests cover every transition and invariant. Fault tests cover malformed inputs, duplicates/reordering, stale anchors/generations, cancellation at every boundary, crash/restart, partial I/O, pressure, authority/privacy revocation, and incompatible versions. A realistic end-to-end script must exercise success plus safe failure through the public semantic surface and retain secret-free structured logs with scenario/seed, fixture/source root, authority/privacy, transition sequence, injected schedule/fault, budgets/observed work, outcome/error identity, decision/output digests, proof handles, cleanup/obligation state, and an exact reproduction command. No log may contain raw private media, credentials, or unbounded payloads.

Verifier independence is supplied by MODEL-INDEPENDENCE-001. In particular, two sizes/checkpoints/prompts of the same VLM are not presumed independent; common training, preprocessing, modality and failure history must be accounted before fusion advances corroboration.
acceptance_criteria:
- Reference fusion produces intervals/sets, alternatives, assumptions, invalidators, missing-data reasons, failure-domain accounting, and an abstention/decision fingerprint.
- Conformal/sequential claims name tested exchangeability/coverage/optional-stopping assumptions and fail closed outside them.
- Tests cover correlated cameras/models, contradictory evidence, missing coverage, optional stopping, delayed corroboration, urgent low-probability high-loss events, and high-confidence benign animals.
- Shadow adaptive fusion cannot mutate thresholds/policy and is compared against the reference with event AUPRC, selective risk, calibration, false alerts/property-day, miss confidence bounds, and latency.
- E2e logs show why alert/wait/abstain/reject occurred and what evidence would change it.

title: Enforce operation-specific maximum tolerable time uncertainty
description:
## Outcome
Require every time-sensitive operation to declare a maximum tolerable capture-time uncertainty and a typed response when exceeded. Each source item retains device time/basis, host monotonic receive time, UTC/property mapping, earliest/latest plausible capture time, exposure/rolling-shutter/encoding/buffering/network/vendor-relay/decode-reorder/quantization/offset-drift uncertainty sources, sequence/discontinuity, and clock generation. Evidence degradation can only widen the interval.

## Decision semantics
Temporal association uses interval overlap and feasible transit intervals, not point equality or an ad hoc wider gate. The same 500 ms may be acceptable for a person crossing a yard and fatal for a fast vehicle/drone or closely spaced cameras. Cross-camera identity, geometry-dependent negative evidence, transit impossibility, and coverage conclusions abstain or degrade when their own tolerance is exceeded. A model cannot narrow time without retained synchronization evidence. Clock calibration methods retain ordered evidence strength, failure models, validation residuals, and generation identity.

## Proof, failure, and observability contract
Use a deterministic safe-Rust reference first.
